reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Longitudinal monocular deprivation/reverse suture, bilateral/dark rearing and multiple cortical recording modalities.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation and transfer check of previous primary Methods, supplements or a validated technical protocol is proposed. Local pilots, welfare approval and promises to fill unknown settings do not meet this separate requirement.

Core exposure duration/intensity, stimulus timing and cortical acquisition/response settings remain a list to select later, without executable quantitative settings or a sufficiently specified calibration-to-setting procedure.

Optical/stimulus and response calibration is named, but quantitative acceptance-to-action thresholds or a concrete derivation of tolerances for eye isolation, delivered contrast and mapping reliability are absent.
Contrasts and clustering are recognized, but the actual response/distribution model, assumption diagnostics and specified multiplicity policy remain incomplete.
Age, exposure dose and stimulus-parameter exploration has no bounded candidate grid or objective range-selection/search-stop rule before locking.
Troubleshooting does not explicitly connect technical changes to a revised frozen procedure and fresh independent confirmation; ordinary initial pilot separation is insufficient.
No complete raw-animal/unit-to-output manifest with calibration records, exact analysis versions/settings and all exclusions/deviations is specified.

checks.quote: Confirm deprived-eye input is below threshold
checks.reason: The protocol verifies ongoing occlusion before each cortical recording and never specifies restored matched optical access for the primary MD endpoint. It also lacks a direct retinal/precortical functional comparator. Cortical loss can therefore reflect blocked/altered input rather than developmental change.

checks.quote: ocular dominance index, eye-specific response ratio
checks.reason: Primary indices and ratios have no formula, response-noise threshold or weak/unresponsive-unit denominator/censoring rule.

Independent/cross-method replication is stated as a future requirement but not operationalized as a confirmation cohort or a defined corroborating comparison; listing alternative recording modalities is insufficient.

Deprivation, restoration and timing contrasts can establish experience dependence but do not uniquely distinguish instruction from permissive maturation. No imposed input structure to resulting organization comparison identifies that stronger mechanism.

historical_match_reason: The question/mechanism and unilateral intervention match. Primary recording still requires below-threshold deprived-eye input, with no common reopening/equivalent afferent input step or upstream comparator. This critical optical/peripheral confound makes the cortical historical readout and experienced-eye developmental conclusion unqualified.
